rationale: The agent initiated and executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. Authentication was not clearly completed; the agent queried two possible emails and fetched a user profile but did not verify identity with the user before acting, nor did it resolve which email/account was correct. The agent also did not provide final confirmation details (e.g., exchange summary, new item/size/color, return label/timeline, or costs). Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
